email.subject: Quick fix for Velvet Group's site
email.body:
Hi Chloe,

I took a look at Velvet Group Hair Studio's website. Two things are likely costing you bookings: the site isn't set up for mobile, so visitors searching on their phones (most local salon searches) probably struggle to even find your hours or book, and the footer still shows outdated info, which can make people second-guess if you're open or current.

I run Northlight Web, a one-person shop that fixes exactly this kind of thing for a flat fee.

Want a free 10-minute walkthrough where I show you what I found and how I'd fix it? No pressure either way.

Alex
